info.title: nupkg-validator: a dotnet tool to validate NuGet packages
info.description: Validates a NuGet packages, are dlls in Release Mode, do they have the right version and public key?

commands.name: validate
commands.description:
Extract a NuGet package and validate the dlls inside it:
release-mode, version numbers, strong-name signing, and optionally
that the package declares no dependencies.

options.name: --assembly-name
options.description: Filter for dll(s) with this assembly name. Defaults to every dll in the package. [default: null]

options.name: --dlls-to-skip
options.description: Comma-separated dll file names to skip validation for. [default: null]

options.name: --expected-version
options.description: Assert this version number was set properly on the dlls. [default: null]

options.name: --not-major-only
options.description: Assert AssemblyVersion equals --expected-version exactly, instead of only its Major.0.0.0 component.

options.name: --public-key
options.description: Assert this public key token is on the dlls' AssemblyName. [default: null]

options.name: --temp-folder
options.description: Where to extract the package contents. Defaults to the OS temp folder. [default: null]

options.name: --skip-release-mode
options.description: Skip validation that the dlls were built in Release mode.

options.name: --no-fail-on-missing-dlls
options.description: Don't fail when no dlls are found (matched by --assembly-name, if given).

options.name: --no-dependencies
options.description: Assert the package declares no dependencies.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: -, --path, Path to the .nupkg file to validate.
